\doxysubsection{Detailed Description}
Builds a module\textquotesingle{}s Port\+Deps from the circuit Sim\+Run holds\+: node indices, gates, assigns\textquotesingle{} read/write sets, always blocks (from the Circ\+Def), and the children\textquotesingle{}s own Port\+Deps mapped through their port definitions.
